words.enDefinition: In British English, a spot assigned to a market seller

examples.en: We booked a market pitch near the entrance for our screen printed bags.
examples.zh: 我们在入口附近订了一个「市集摊位」，卖我们丝网印制的包。

examples.en: Our market pitch was beside the stairs, so we used a narrow table.
examples.zh: 我们的「市集摊位」在楼梯边，所以用了张窄桌子。

words.enDefinition: A seller's request for permission to trade at an event

examples.en: The ceramics club sent in a vendor application for the spring market.
examples.zh: 陶艺社递交了春季市集的「摊商报名申请」。

examples.en: We mentioned the size of our table in the vendor application this year.
examples.zh: 我们在今年的「摊商报名申请」里写了桌子的尺寸。

words.enDefinition: The process of confirming a seller's arrival at an event

examples.en: Our team completed vendor check-in before carrying the boxes into the hall.
examples.zh: 我们组先办了「摊商签到」，再把箱子搬进大厅。

examples.en: I asked where the power outlets were during vendor check-in while my friend unloaded.
examples.zh: 朋友在卸货，我趁「摊商签到」问了插座的位置。

words.enDefinition: A set of instructions and information prepared for event sellers

examples.en: The vendor packet shows where we can unload our boxes on Saturday.
examples.zh: 「摊商资料包」里标了周六可以在哪里卸下箱子。

examples.en: I checked the vendor packet for the size of tables available for rent.
examples.zh: 我查了「摊商资料包」，看看能租到多大的桌子。

collocations: the vendor packet includes a map

words.enDefinition: The arrangement of items and equipment within a market stall

examples.en: We sketched the stall layout before deciding which shelves to bring to campus.
examples.zh: 决定带哪些架子来学校之前，我们画了张「摊位布局」草图。

examples.en: The new stall layout leaves enough space for people to browse the prints.
examples.zh: 新的「摊位布局」留出了足够空间，让人慢慢看版画。

words.enDefinition: A small stand used to raise items above table level

examples.en: I put the enamel pins on a table riser behind the postcards.
examples.zh: 我把珐琅徽章放在明信片后面的「桌面陈列增高架」上。

examples.en: The little table riser made our bowls easier to see from the aisle.
examples.zh: 小小的「桌面陈列增高架」让人从过道就能看到我们的碗。

collocations: place a product on a table riser

words.enDefinition: A stand that holds a sign or picture upright for viewing

examples.en: A small display easel held the club's poster at the front of the stall.
examples.zh: 一架小「陈列画架」在摊位前支着社团的海报。

examples.en: I brought a display easel to show the larger of my two prints.
examples.zh: 我带了一个「陈列画架」，展示我两幅版画中较大的那幅。

collocations: prop something up on a display easel

words.enDefinition: An arrangement of products on several levels to improve visibility

examples.en: A tiered display made the small ceramic cups visible behind the taller mugs.
examples.zh: 用「阶梯式陈列」摆放，高马克杯后面的小陶瓷杯也能看见。

examples.en: We built a tiered display from three sturdy boxes and a piece of fabric.
examples.zh: 我们用三个结实的箱子和一块布做了个「阶梯式陈列」。

collocations: use a tiered display for small items

words.enDefinition: A hook used to hang items where shoppers can see them

examples.en: I hung the key chains from a display hook beside the handwritten sign.
examples.zh: 我把钥匙扣挂在手写招牌旁的「商品陈列挂钩」上。

examples.en: The earrings were light enough to share a single display hook on the board.
examples.zh: 耳环够轻，可以几副一起挂在板上的同一个「陈列挂钩」上。

collocations: hang an item on a display hook

words.enDefinition: A shallow container used to arrange products so customers can see them

examples.en: We kept the little badges in a display tray next to the mirror.
examples.zh: 我们把小徽章放在镜子旁边的「商品陈列托盘」里。

examples.en: I switched to a divided display tray so the colors would stay separate.
examples.zh: 我换了一个带隔格的「陈列托盘」，免得不同颜色的货混在一起。

collocations: arrange items in a display tray

words.enDefinition: A frame used to hold up the background behind a display

examples.en: We hung a plain piece of fabric from the backdrop stand behind our table.
examples.zh: 我们在桌子后面的「背景布支架」上挂了块素布。

examples.en: The backdrop stand fitted behind the table without taking up the next seller’s space.
examples.zh: 「背景布支架」正好放在桌子后面，没有占到旁边摊商的地方。

collocations: hang fabric on a backdrop stand

words.enDefinition: An item kept out to show customers how a product works

examples.en: We brought one demo unit so visitors could try the folding book stand.
examples.zh: 我们带了一个「演示用样品」，让来逛的人试用折叠书架。

examples.en: The demo unit let people hear what the little wooden speaker sounded like.
examples.zh: 顾客可以用「演示用样品」试听小木音箱的声音。

collocations: keep a demo unit on the table

words.enDefinition: A small piece of material shown to demonstrate its color or texture

examples.en: I showed a sample swatch of the canvas before she ordered a tote.
examples.zh: 她订手提袋之前，我给她看了「一小块帆布样品」。

examples.en: The maker attached a sample swatch to each card on the color board.
examples.zh: 制作人给色板上的每张卡片都贴了「一小块样布」。

words.enDefinition: A tag identifying a specific version of a product

examples.en: I checked the variant label before putting the small tote into its bag.
examples.zh: 把小号手提包放进袋子前，我核对了「商品规格标签」。

examples.en: The variant label on the box told me which fabric the customer had picked.
examples.zh: 盒子上的「商品规格标签」让我知道顾客选了哪种面料。

words.enDefinition: The range of sizes carried for one style of product

examples.en: We brought a full size run of the club shirts to the first market.
examples.zh: 我们第一次出摊带齐了社团 T 恤的「一整套尺码」。

examples.en: After lunch, only the navy sweatshirt still had a full size run available.
examples.zh: 午饭后，只有藏蓝色卫衣还「尺码齐全」。

words.enDefinition: A small sign showing the price of a displayed item

examples.en: I put a price card beside each stack so customers could browse quietly.
examples.zh: 我在每摞商品旁都放了张「标价卡」，让顾客可以安静地选购。

examples.en: We printed a new price card when we added the larger sketchbooks to the table.
examples.zh: 我们把大号素描本也摆上桌时，印了一张新的「标价卡」。

words.enDefinition: A handheld device that prints and applies small price labels

examples.en: We borrowed a price gun to label the notebooks before taking them to campus.
examples.zh: 我们借了把「打价标签枪」，给笔记本贴好价格再带去学校。

examples.en: One person used the price gun while another stacked the cards by design.
examples.zh: 一个人用「打价标签枪」贴标价，另一个人按图案把卡片叠好。

words.enDefinition: A reusable container used for carrying or storing goods to sell

examples.en: We labeled each stock bin before loading the folding cart for the market.
examples.zh: 把货装上折叠推车带去市集前，我们给每个「库存周转箱」贴了标签。

examples.en: The second stock bin stayed under the table until the postcard rack was empty.
examples.zh: 明信片架子空掉之前，第二个「库存周转箱」一直放在桌下。

words.enDefinition: Space beneath a table used to store equipment or extra goods

examples.en: We left the under-table storage clear for bags and boxes already sold.
examples.zh: 我们把「桌下储物空间」空出来，放已卖出的袋子和盒子。

examples.en: The longer table gave us enough under-table storage for the extra stock.
examples.zh: 长桌给我们留出了足够的「桌下储物空间」来存放额外的货。

words.enDefinition: A sign showing where people should stand while waiting in line

examples.en: We moved the queue marker away from the entrance after the first rush.
examples.zh: 第一波人潮散了之后，我们把「排队位置标记」从入口旁移开了。

examples.en: A small queue marker kept the pickup line separate from people browsing the stall.
examples.zh: 一个小小的「排队位置标记」把取货队伍和正在逛摊位的人分开了。

words.enDefinition: A mirror shoppers can use to see how clothing fits

examples.en: We set a fitting mirror behind the rail so people could try on jackets.
examples.zh: 我们在衣架后面放了面「试穿镜」，方便顾客试夹克。

examples.en: The fitting mirror was taller than our usual one and barely fitted in the car.
examples.zh: 这面「试穿镜」比平时用的要高，差一点就塞不进车里。

words.enDefinition: A presentation of products grouped together as a single purchase

examples.en: The bundle display showed how the small notebook and pen looked together.
examples.zh: 「套装陈列」让来客看到小笔记本和笔搭配起来的效果。

examples.en: We made a separate bundle display for the sets of postcards and stickers.
examples.zh: 我们把明信片加贴纸的套装放在一起，做了个单独的「套装陈列」。

words.enDefinition: a customer who comes directly to a stall, desk or counter without booking or ordering first

examples.en: I kept two blue bags for any walk-up customer who asked about them.
examples.zh: 我留了两个蓝色包，免得有「未预约的现场顾客」来问却没货。

examples.en: A walk-up customer bought the last print while we were checking our reservations.
examples.zh: 我们核对预订时，一位「未预约的现场顾客」买走了最后一幅版画。

collocations: a sale to a walk-up customer

words.enDefinition: A sign designed to withstand exposure to outdoor weather

examples.en: Our weatherproof sign stayed legible through the brief rain at the outdoor market.
examples.zh: 室外市集上下了阵雨，我们的「耐风雨招牌」还是看得清。

examples.en: We put a weatherproof sign by the gate so customers could find the stall.
examples.zh: 我们在大门旁立了块「耐风雨招牌」，让顾客能找到摊位。

words.enDefinition: Take apart a stall and put its equipment away after trading

examples.en: We waited for the last pickup before we began to pack down the stall.
examples.zh: 等最后一位顾客取完货，我们才开始「收摊收设备」。

examples.en: Could you help me pack down the stall once the other sellers clear the aisle?
examples.zh: 等其他摊商把过道清出来，你能帮我「收摊撤掉设备」吗？

collocations: start to pack down the stall
pack down the stall at closing time

words.enDefinition: A regular count of a selected part of the inventory

examples.en: We did a cycle count of the notebooks instead of counting every product again.
examples.zh: 我们只对笔记本做了次「循环盘点」，所有商品都重数一遍就免了。

examples.en: The cycle count this week will cover the cards kept in the studio cupboard.
examples.zh: 本周的「循环盘点」会数工作室柜子里的卡片。

words.enDefinition: A form used to record quantities during a physical count

examples.en: Tariq marked the opened boxes on the count sheet as we counted them.
examples.zh: 我们数到开过的箱子时，塔里克在「盘点记录表」上作了标记。

examples.en: I left the count sheet near the shelf so we could update it together.
examples.zh: 我把「盘点记录表」放在架子旁边，方便我们一起更新。

words.enDefinition: A count of the actual items present at a location

examples.en: We did a physical count before loading the prints and found two extra copies.
examples.zh: 装版画前我们做了次「实物盘点」，发现多了两张。

examples.en: The physical count included mugs we planned to put aside for Saturday's pickups.
examples.zh: 「实物盘点」把我们打算留给周六取货的那些马克杯也数进去了。

collocations: verify stock with a physical count

words.enDefinition: A difference between recorded stock and the quantity actually present

examples.en: We noticed a stock discrepancy after counting the clips left in the storage box.
examples.zh: 数完收纳盒里剩下的夹子后，我们发现了一处「库存数量不符」。

examples.en: An unrecorded sample explained the stock discrepancy between our sheet and the shelf.
examples.zh: 一件未登记的样品，正好解释了清单和货架之间的「库存数量不符」。

words.enDefinition: A change to the recorded quantity of goods in inventory

examples.en: I made a stock adjustment after we found two damaged sketchbooks in the crate.
examples.zh: 我们在箱子里发现两本破损的素描本后，我做了「库存调整」。

examples.en: The stock adjustment added three bags we had missed in the first count.
examples.zh: 这次「库存调整」补进了第一次盘点漏数的三个包。

words.enDefinition: A transfer or quantity change tracked in an inventory system

examples.en: We logged a stock movement for the box we took from the studio to campus.
examples.zh: 我们把从工作室运到学校的那箱货记成了一条「库存变动」。

examples.en: The spreadsheet shows each stock movement between the market stall and our storage cupboard.
examples.zh: 电子表格记着摊位和存货柜之间每一笔「库存变动」。

words.enDefinition: A notification that the quantity of an item is running low

examples.en: The low-stock alert went off when we had three green mugs left to sell.
examples.zh: 还剩三个绿马克杯可卖时，系统发出了「库存不足提醒」。

examples.en: I set a low-stock alert for envelopes before we scheduled another print market.
examples.zh: 安排下一场版画市集前，我给信封设了个「库存不足提醒」。

collocations: a low-stock alert for each variant

words.enDefinition: The stock quantity that signals it is time to reorder

examples.en: We reached the reorder point for blank cards sooner than expected this month.
examples.zh: 这个月空白卡片的库存比预想中更早降到了「需要补货的数量」。

examples.en: I raised the reorder point for tote bags before the start of term.
examples.zh: 开学前，我提高了手提袋的「补货触发库存量」。

words.enDefinition: A sheet for keeping a count by making a mark per occurrence

examples.en: I used a tally sheet to count how many bookmarks we sold each hour.
examples.zh: 我用「划记统计表」记每小时卖了多少书签。

examples.en: There was a mark on the tally sheet for every mug we took out.
examples.zh: 每拿出一个马克杯，「划记统计表」上就添一道。

collocations: keep a tally sheet by the counter

words.enDefinition: Space on shelves available for holding or displaying goods

examples.en: We ran out of shelf space once we unpacked the new greeting cards.
examples.zh: 新到的贺卡一拆包，我们的「货架陈列空间」就不够了。

examples.en: The bowls take up more shelf space than the coasters we sold last term.
examples.zh: 碗比上学期卖的杯垫占用的「货架陈列空间」更多。

words.enDefinition: The designated place where a particular item is kept in storage

examples.en: The bin location on the list told me where to find spare bag handles.
examples.zh: 清单上的「储物格位置」告诉我备用提手放在哪儿。

examples.en: We marked the bin location next to each item in the studio spreadsheet.
examples.zh: 我们在工作室的电子表格里，把「储物格位置」写在每件商品旁边。

words.enDefinition: a readily accessible shelf or slot from which workers routinely pick stock to fill orders

examples.en: I kept the front bin as a pick face for the smallest cards.
examples.zh: 我用前面的那格作为小卡片的「前置拣货位」。

examples.en: We filled the pick face from boxes in the back before pickup opened.
examples.zh: 开放取货前，我们从后面的箱子里拿货，补满了「前置拣货位」。

words.enDefinition: Goods expected to arrive but not yet received or recorded on hand

examples.en: We cleared a shelf for incoming stock before the new mugs arrived Friday.
examples.zh: 周五新马克杯送到前，我们腾出了一个架子放「待入库的货」。

examples.en: The incoming stock includes three packs of bags we need for next week.
examples.zh: 「待入库货品」里有我们下周要用的三包袋子。

words.enDefinition: Goods that are currently in suitable condition and available for sale

examples.en: We took cracked mugs out of sellable inventory before counting the remaining stock.
examples.zh: 数剩余存货之前，我们把有裂纹的马克杯从「可售库存」中剔除了。

examples.en: I checked sellable inventory before telling the club how many bags they could buy.
examples.zh: 告诉社团他们能买多少袋子之前，我查了「可售库存」。

words.enDefinition: Individual items set aside for a customer or a specific order

examples.en: I kept the reserved units in a separate box beside the packing table.
examples.zh: 我把这些「已预留的货」放在打包桌旁边的另一个箱子里。

examples.en: There were four reserved units for people who had ordered the larger mugs.
examples.zh: 已订大号马克杯的人有「四件预留的货」。

collocations: mark reserved units in the spreadsheet

words.enDefinition: Goods in storage that have been harmed and may be unsellable

examples.en: We put damaged stock in a separate crate so it couldn't be sold accidentally.
examples.zh: 我们把「破损库存」放进另一个周转箱，防止误卖。

examples.en: The ceramics crew checked for damaged stock before folding the tables for the night.
examples.zh: 陶艺组当晚收折叠桌前，先检查有没有「破损库存」。

words.enDefinition: organising stock so items that should be used or sold sooner are taken first, such as older or sooner-expiring items

examples.en: Our stock rotation kept the older rolls of paper at the front of the cupboard.
examples.zh: 我们按「库存轮换」的办法，把较早进的纸卷放在柜子前面。

examples.en: I put dates on the boxes to make stock rotation easier for the next market.
examples.zh: 我在箱子上标日期，方便下次摆摊前进行「库存轮换」。

words.enDefinition: Put more stock on display when the existing supply runs low

examples.en: Can you replenish the shelf with the small sketchbooks before the morning crowd arrives?
examples.zh: 上午顾客多起来之前，你能拿些小素描本「给货架补货」吗？

examples.en: We needed to replenish the shelf twice because the larger prints sold faster than expected.
examples.zh: 大幅版画卖得比想象中快，我们不得不「给货架补了两次货」。

words.enDefinition: Extra bags or wrapping kept in case more are needed

examples.en: We brought spare packaging because the larger tote bags didn't fit the small sleeves.
examples.zh: 大号托特包装不进小封套，所以我们带了「备用包装材料」。

examples.en: I used our spare packaging when the corner of the first envelope split.
examples.zh: 第一个信封的角破了，我就用了「备用包装材料」。

words.enDefinition: A delivery containing only part of what was ordered

examples.en: We got a partial delivery of blank journals before opening our end of term booth.
examples.zh: 学期末摆摊前，我们订的空白手账本「只送到了一部分」。

examples.en: Our supplier offered a partial delivery on Tuesday and the rest the following week.
examples.zh: 供货商提出周二「先交付部分货物」，剩下的下一周再送。

words.enDefinition: The number of items that actually arrived in a delivery

examples.en: The quantity received was lower than expected, so we counted the envelopes again.
examples.zh: 「实际收货数量」比预期少，我们又数了一遍信封。

examples.en: I recorded the quantity received beside each fabric color in the studio notebook.
examples.zh: 我在工作室的本子上，记下了每种颜色的面料「实际收到多少」。

collocations: check the quantity received against the order

words.enDefinition: The amount by which a delivery falls short of the order

examples.en: We tracked the delivery shortfall after only half our thank-you cards arrived on Monday.
examples.zh: 周一只收到一半感谢卡后，我们记下了「少交付的数量」。

examples.en: The supplier offered to make up the delivery shortfall before Saturday's student market.
examples.zh: 供应商说会在周六学生市集之前「把少交的货」补齐。

words.enDefinition: Record an arriving shipment after verifying which items it contains

examples.en: I helped check in a delivery while the other students prepared our samples for display.
examples.zh: 其他同学在准备展示样品时，我帮忙「登记了一批到货」。

examples.en: We needed to check in a delivery before adding the new stickers to our stock count.
examples.zh: 把新贴纸加进库存前，我们得先「登记这批到货」。

collocations: check in a delivery from a supplier
check in a delivery at the studio
check in a delivery against the list

words.enDefinition: Divide goods between separate places where they are stored or sold

examples.en: We decided to split stock between locations because our club was selling on two campuses.
examples.zh: 社团要在两个校区卖东西，所以我们决定「把库存分放两处」。

examples.en: Can we split stock between locations without leaving the downtown stall short of sketchbooks?
examples.zh: 我们能「把库存分放两处」，同时确保市中心的摊位有够用的素描本吗？

collocations: agree to split stock between locations
plan to split stock between locations
split stock between locations for the weekend

words.enDefinition: Items set aside to show customers before they decide to buy

examples.en: We brought sample stock so buyers could feel each fabric before placing an order.
examples.zh: 我们带了「备好的样品」，这样买家下单前能摸摸各种面料。

examples.en: Keep the sample stock on this side so nobody includes it in today's sales count.
examples.zh: 把「样品库存」放这边，别让人把它也计入今天的销量。

collocations: bring sample stock to a market

words.enDefinition: Goods kept in the selling area to be seen by customers

examples.en: We moved the display stock inside when rain started blowing across the tables.
examples.zh: 雨开始随风扫到桌上时，我们就把「陈列中的货」搬进了室内。

examples.en: The last two journals we sold came from the display stock on the shelf.
examples.zh: 我们卖掉的最后两本手账是从架上的「陈列商品」里拿的。

words.enDefinition: A supply of goods in excess of what is needed

examples.en: The green notebooks became overstock after we ordered too many in spring.
examples.zh: 春天绿皮笔记本订得太多，后来就「库存过剩」了。

examples.en: The library helped us clear our overstock by buying the extra blank journals.
examples.zh: 图书馆买下了多余的空白手账本，帮我们清掉了「过剩库存」。

words.enDefinition: Goods that have remained unsold and are unlikely to sell

examples.en: The old event shirts became dead stock once that year's design was replaced.
examples.zh: 活动 T 恤的旧款被当年新设计替换后，就成了「积压滞销库存」。

examples.en: I found two boxes of dead stock while clearing the studio for next term.
examples.zh: 我在收拾工作室准备下学期用时，发现了两箱「积压滞销库存」。

words.enDefinition: Sell all of the goods that are still available

examples.en: We hope to sell through the remaining stock before the studio closes for the summer.
examples.zh: 我们希望工作室暑期关闭前「卖完剩余存货」。

examples.en: The club needed to sell through the remaining stock before opening orders for this year's design.
examples.zh: 社团得先「卖完剩余存货」，才能开放今年新设计的订购。

collocations: aim to sell through the remaining stock
try to sell through the remaining stock
sell through the remaining stock by June

words.enDefinition: The process of receiving and recording new orders for work

examples.en: We moved order intake to a shared form after losing two paper notes.
examples.zh: 弄丢两张纸条之后，我们改用共享表单「接收和登记订单」。

examples.en: Amira handled order intake while I checked how many bags we could still make.
examples.zh: 阿米拉负责「接单登记」，我去查我们还能做多少个包。

words.enDefinition: The latest time when orders are accepted for a particular batch

examples.en: Our order cutoff is Thursday at noon for anyone collecting prints on Friday.
examples.zh: 想周五来取版画的话，我们的「截单时间」是周四中午。

examples.en: I set the order cutoff early enough to pack everything before my evening class.
examples.zh: 我把「截单时间」设得够早，这样上晚课前能打包好所有东西。

words.enDefinition: Stop an order form from accepting any more customer submissions

examples.en: We'll close the order form once we have enough requests for the first print run.
examples.zh: 第一轮印刷攒够订单后，我们就「关闭下单表单」。

examples.en: I forgot to close the order form and found three extra requests the next morning.
examples.zh: 我忘了「关闭下单表单」，第二天早上发现多了三笔订单。

collocations: remember to close the order form
decide when to close the order form
close the order form at noon

words.enDefinition: A customer request to change an item for their particular needs

examples.en: A custom request came in for a notebook with two initials on the cover.
examples.zh: 有人提了个「定制需求」，想给笔记本封面印两个姓名首字母。

examples.en: I checked the custom request before choosing which color of thread to use.
examples.zh: 选用哪种颜色的线之前，我核对了「定制需求」。

words.enDefinition: A form field where customers enter details for a customised item

examples.en: The personalisation field tells us which name to print on the bag.
examples.zh: 「个性化定制输入栏」告诉我们应该在包上印哪个名字。

examples.en: I left the personalisation field optional for people who wanted plain labels.
examples.zh: 我把「个性化定制输入栏」设成选填，方便只要普通标签的顾客。

words.enDefinition: An extra product that can be added to the main purchase

examples.en: We offered a spare bookmark as an add-on item for the notebook orders.
examples.zh: 我们为下单笔记本的顾客提供一个备用书签作为「加购商品」。

examples.en: The gift sleeve was an add-on item, so I counted it separately.
examples.zh: 礼品封套是「额外加购的商品」，所以我把它单独计算。

words.enDefinition: A single order created from items that were requested separately

examples.en: The two roommates asked us to make a combined order for one pickup.
examples.zh: 两个室友请我们把他们的需求「合成一笔订单」，一起取货。

examples.en: Our combined order included postcards for three people in the same house.
examples.zh: 我们的「合并订单」里有同一住处三个人要的明信片。

collocations: a combined order for two people

words.enDefinition: An order prepared but not yet finalised as a customer purchase

examples.en: I saved a draft order while the customer decided which notebook cover they wanted.
examples.zh: 顾客还在选要哪个笔记本封面，我就先保存了「订单草稿」。

examples.en: The draft order was still open when we got the correct spelling of her name.
examples.zh: 收到她名字的正确拼写时，「订单草稿」还没定稿。

words.enDefinition: A change made to the details of an existing order

examples.en: I wrote down the order amendment so we would pack the smaller print.
examples.zh: 我记下了这次「订单修改」，这样我们就会装较小的那幅版画。

examples.en: We confirmed the order amendment before adding a second notebook to her bag.
examples.zh: 我们先确认了「订单修改」，才往她的袋子里多放了一本笔记本。

words.enDefinition: An order that still needs work before it can be closed

examples.en: There was one open order left for a tote bag with longer handles.
examples.zh: 还剩一笔「待处理订单」，要的是带长提手的手提包。

examples.en: I checked every open order before promising the remaining stock to walk-ups.
examples.zh: 答应把剩下的货卖给现场顾客之前，我检查了每笔「待处理订单」。

words.enDefinition: A record of the orders a seller has received

examples.en: The order log showed which notebooks still needed a name on the cover.
examples.zh: 「订单登记表」上写着哪些笔记本的封面还需要加名字。

examples.en: I entered the phone order in our order log after speaking to the customer.
examples.zh: 与顾客通完话后，我把这笔电话订单录入了「订单登记表」。

words.enDefinition: The sequence of orders waiting to be handled or completed

examples.en: One person watched the order queue while the rest of us packed boxes.
examples.zh: 一个人盯着「待处理订单队列」，其他人都在打包。

examples.en: The order queue filled up with bag orders after the club posted our photos.
examples.zh: 社团发了我们的照片后，「待处理订单队列」里一下子挤满了买包的订单。

words.enDefinition: A period booked or offered for a service to happen

examples.en: I offered a later service slot when the student couldn't bring the jacket before lunch.
examples.zh: 那位同学午饭前送不来夹克，我就给了晚一点的「服务预约时段」。

examples.en: We left one service slot free for a club member who needed a repair.
examples.zh: 我们留了一个「服务预约时段」，给有东西需要修的社团成员。

words.enDefinition: An appointment arranged after a customer arrives without booking ahead

examples.en: We could offer a walk-in appointment for a quick consultation at the repair table.
examples.zh: 我们在维修台可以让人「现场登记预约」，做个简短咨询。

examples.en: The poster explains when students can get a walk-in appointment for a mending lesson.
examples.zh: 海报说明了同学们什么时候可以「现场登记预约」学衣物缝补。

words.enDefinition: A calendar showing reserved and available times for appointments

examples.en: I checked the booking calendar before offering another time for the portrait session.
examples.zh: 我看了「预约日历」，才为人像拍摄另提了一个时间。

examples.en: The booking calendar made it easy to see which afternoons we could still offer.
examples.zh: 从「预约日历」上很容易看出哪些下午还可以约。

collocations: block time on the booking calendar

words.enDefinition: A small gap kept between appointments to allow for delays

examples.en: We added an appointment buffer so there was time to reset the portrait backdrop.
examples.zh: 我们加了「预约间隔缓冲时间」，有时间整理人像拍摄的背景。

examples.en: Without an appointment buffer, one long repair pushed every later booking back.
examples.zh: 因为没留「预约间隔缓冲时间」，一单修得久，后面的预约全晚了。

words.enDefinition: The time needed to complete an order after receiving it

examples.en: We shortened order turnaround by keeping extra handles ready to sew onto bags.
examples.zh: 我们多备了些能直接缝到包上的提手，缩短了「订单周转时间」。

examples.en: I estimated the order turnaround before agreeing to make another set of mugs.
examples.zh: 答应再做一套马克杯之前，我先估算了「订单周转时间」。

words.enDefinition: the time range in which an order can be collected on the same day it is placed

examples.en: The bakery posted a same-day pickup window for orders placed before its noon cutoff.
examples.zh: 烘焙店为中午截单前下的订单发布了「当天自取时段」。

examples.en: I chose the same-day pickup window so I could collect the prints after class.
examples.zh: 我选了「当天自取时段」，这样下课就能拿版画。

words.enDefinition: A period reserved for making a certain item or batch

examples.en: We reserved a production slot for the custom bags before borrowing the sewing machine.
examples.zh: 借缝纫机之前，我们先为定制包「预留了制作时段」。

examples.en: There was one production slot left before the studio closed for the holiday.
examples.zh: 工作室放假前还剩一个「制作时段」可预留。

words.enDefinition: Produce items in groups instead of making each one separately

examples.en: The canvas bags are easy to make in batches because they all use the same pattern.
examples.zh: 帆布包用的都是同样的纸样，所以很容易「分批制作」。

examples.en: We chose items to make in batches on the afternoons when the studio was quiet.
examples.zh: 我们选了一些可以在工作室清静的下午「分批制作」的商品。

collocations: choose items to make in batches

words.enDefinition: Finished items that can be sold without further production work

examples.en: We brought some ready-made stock for shoppers who did not want to place orders.
examples.zh: 我们带了些「已做好的现货」，给不想提前下单的顾客。

examples.en: I kept ready-made stock separate from bags that still needed names sewn onto them.
examples.zh: 我把「已做好的现货」和还需要缝名字的包分开放。

collocations: offer ready-made stock alongside custom orders

words.enDefinition: A slip containing the instructions for a specific piece of work

examples.en: I attached a job ticket to the tote that needed a longer strap.
examples.zh: 我把一张「作业工单」贴在需要加长背带的托特包上。

examples.en: The job ticket listed which part of the jacket the student wanted mended.
examples.zh: 「作业工单」写了那位同学想补夹克的哪个部位。

words.enDefinition: Pause an order until an issue is resolved or information arrives

examples.en: We had to hold an order because the customer hadn't picked a thread color.
examples.zh: 顾客还没选线的颜色，所以我们得「暂缓处理一笔订单」。

examples.en: I asked the stall to hold an order until we could confirm the new quantity.
examples.zh: 我请摊位那边「暂缓处理一笔订单」，等我们确认新的数量。

collocations: ask us to hold an order
hold an order until the details are confirmed

words.enDefinition: Verify that the customer accepts a different item in the order

examples.en: I called to confirm a substitution before packing the cream bag instead of the white one.
examples.zh: 我先打电话「确认替换商品」，才把白色包换成米白色的装进去。

examples.en: We needed to confirm a substitution because we only had larger envelopes left.
examples.zh: 只剩较大的信封了，所以我们得先「确认能不能替换」。

collocations: confirm a substitution with the customer
ask someone to confirm a substitution
need to confirm a substitution before packing

words.enDefinition: An order that needs to be completed sooner than normal

examples.en: We accepted one rush order for the club that needed badges by Thursday.
examples.zh: 那个社团周四之前就要拿到徽章，我们接了一笔他们的「加急订单」。

examples.en: I could take the rush order because all the notebooks already had covers.
examples.zh: 所有笔记本都已经有封面了，所以我能接这笔「加急订单」。

words.enDefinition: The process of preparing an order and getting it to the customer

examples.en: We handled order fulfilment ourselves, from sorting the stock to handing over each bag.
examples.zh: 从整理库存到把一个个袋子交给顾客，整个「订单履约」过程都由我们自己负责。

examples.en: The group moved order fulfilment to the studio so orders could be packed indoors.
examples.zh: 小组把「订单履约」移到工作室，这样可以在室内打包。

words.enDefinition: Prepare the requested goods and get them to the customer

examples.en: We couldn't fulfil an order for twenty mugs with only twelve in the cupboard.
examples.zh: 柜子里只有十二个马克杯，没法「履行那笔要二十个杯子的订单」。

examples.en: I could fulfil an order from our remaining stock without making another print run.
examples.zh: 我用剩余库存就能「完成一笔订单」，不用再印一批。

collocations: be able to fulfil an order

words.enDefinition: Having some ordered items supplied while others are still outstanding

examples.en: I marked the order partially fulfilled because the customer took only the prints.
examples.zh: 顾客只拿走了版画，所以我把订单标成「已部分履约」。

examples.en: The mug order remained partially fulfilled until we delivered the last two boxes.
examples.zh: 最后两箱还没交付前，马克杯订单一直显示「已部分履约」。

words.enDefinition: Selecting the correct items from stored stock for specific orders

examples.en: We did order picking in the cupboard before anyone started sealing the envelopes.
examples.zh: 大家开始封信封前，我们先从柜子里「按单拣货」。

examples.en: Our color labels made order picking easier when the team packed after class.
examples.zh: 小组下课后打包时，色标让「按单拣货」更容易。

words.enDefinition: A document listing what to collect from storage for an order

examples.en: The pick ticket told me to take one notebook from the upper shelf.
examples.zh: 「拣货单」上写着从上层架子拿一本笔记本。

examples.en: I attached the pick ticket to the basket while I looked for matching cards.
examples.zh: 我把「拣货单」夹在篮子上，然后去找配套的卡片。

words.enDefinition: Select items from storage and package them for individual orders

examples.en: We can pick and pack all the print orders before our afternoon lab.
examples.zh: 我们能在下午的实验课前，把所有版画订单「拣好货并打包」。

examples.en: I offered to pick and pack while the maker finished painting the last bowl.
examples.zh: 制作同学在给最后一个碗上色，我提出帮忙「拣货并打包」。

words.enDefinition: A place set up with supplies for packing orders or parcels

examples.en: We set up a packing station with tape and boxes behind the stall.
examples.zh: 我们在摊位后设了一个「打包装货工位」，备好胶带和盒子。

examples.en: I left the tissue paper at the packing station before going to class.
examples.zh: 去上课前，我把包装薄纸留在了「打包装货工位」。

words.enDefinition: A check that the contents of a package match an order

examples.en: The final packing check caught a white bag in an order for navy.
examples.zh: 最后一次「打包核对」发现，有人把要藏蓝色的订单装成了白包。

examples.en: We added a packing check after two notebook orders got mixed up last week.
examples.zh: 上周两笔笔记本订单弄混了，我们加了一道「打包核对」。

words.enDefinition: A stiff sheet placed behind a flat item for support

examples.en: We slid a backing board behind each poster before putting it into a sleeve.
examples.zh: 把海报放进封套前，我们在每张后面都垫了块「防弯背板」。

examples.en: The backing board kept the print from bending while I carried it across campus.
examples.zh: 我带着版画穿过校园时，「防弯背板」防止它弯折。

words.enDefinition: A thin cover used to protect an item from damage

examples.en: I slid the finished cards into a protective sleeve before labelling the order.
examples.zh: 给订单贴标签之前，我把做好的卡片装进了「防护封套」。

examples.en: The artist sold every print in a protective sleeve to protect its surface.
examples.zh: 画手给每幅出售的版画都加了「防护封套」，保护它的表面。

collocations: slip something into a protective sleeve

words.enDefinition: Material inserted to fill empty space around goods inside a package

examples.en: We added paper void fill so the small bowl wouldn't move in transit.
examples.zh: 我们加了纸质「包装空隙填料」，小碗在运输时就不会晃动。

examples.en: The larger boxes needed more void fill around the mugs before we sealed them.
examples.zh: 大盒子封口前，马克杯周围得多加一些「包装空隙填料」。

words.enDefinition: Shredded paper folded into crinkles for decoration or cushioning in boxes

examples.en: I used crinkle paper to hold the small gift box in place.
examples.zh: 我用了「皱褶填充纸条」来固定小礼盒。

examples.en: The extra crinkle paper was in a drawer beside our packing table.
examples.zh: 多余的「皱褶填充纸条」放在打包桌旁边的抽屉里。

collocations: fill a box with crinkle paper

words.enDefinition: A strip on packaging designed to be pulled to open it

examples.en: We chose an envelope with a tear strip so customers could open it easily.
examples.zh: 我们选了带「易撕封条」的信封，顾客拆起来方便。

examples.en: The tear strip on the sample box came off too easily during transport.
examples.zh: 样品盒的「易撕封条」在运输途中太容易脱落。

collocations: a box with a tear strip

words.enDefinition: Having a closure that sticks after a protective strip is removed

examples.en: I bought peel-and-seal envelopes so we wouldn't need tape for each order.
examples.zh: 我买了「揭纸即粘的」信封，这样每笔订单就不用另贴胶带。

examples.en: The peel-and-seal bags worked well for the smallest cards on our table.
examples.zh: 「揭纸即粘的」袋子很适合装我们桌上最小的卡片。

words.enDefinition: A small card carrying a personal message included with a gift

examples.en: I tucked the gift message card into the bag before sticking the label on.
examples.zh: 贴标签前，我把「礼品留言卡」塞进了袋子。

examples.en: The gift message card went with the blue mug, according to the order details.
examples.zh: 按订单详情，「礼品留言卡」应和蓝色马克杯放在一起。

words.enDefinition: Attach an identifying tag to every bag so orders stay separate

examples.en: Please label each bag with the order number before you put it on the shelf.
examples.zh: 请先「逐袋贴好标签」写上订单号，再把袋子放到架子上。

examples.en: We had to label each bag because three different people ordered the same mug.
examples.zh: 有三个人订了同款马克杯，所以我们得「逐袋贴标签」。

collocations: label each bag with a name

words.enDefinition: Put items into different packages instead of packing them together

examples.en: Please pack separately when two people have paid for items in the same set.
examples.zh: 同一套商品由两个人分别付款时，请「分开打包」。

examples.en: We can pack separately if the tall cups don't fit beside the small bowls.
examples.zh: 高一点的杯子如果放不进小碗旁边，我们可以「分开打包」。

words.enDefinition: An instance of collecting fewer units than an order requires

examples.en: I reported a short pick when the last carton only held two mugs.
examples.zh: 最后一箱只有两个马克杯，我上报了「拣货数量不足」的情况。

examples.en: The team recorded a short pick after they couldn't find the final postcard pack.
examples.zh: 小组没找到最后一包明信片，于是登记了「拣货数量不足」。

words.enDefinition: An instance of choosing an incorrect item to fill an order

examples.en: We spotted a mispick when a green mug turned up in the bag.
examples.zh: 我们发现袋里有个绿马克杯，就知道「拣错货」了。

examples.en: I recorded the mispick before swapping the large shirt for a medium.
examples.zh: 我先登记了这次「拣货错误」，再把大号 T 恤换成中号。

words.enDefinition: A record of orders expected to be collected in person

examples.en: The pickup list showed which orders belonged at the table near the entrance.
examples.zh: 「取货订单清单」标出了哪些订单该放在入口旁的桌子上。

examples.en: I checked the pickup list before carrying the last three packages to campus.
examples.zh: 把最后三个包裹带到学校前，我核对了「取货订单清单」。

collocations: cross names off the pickup list

words.enDefinition: A message reminding a customer to collect an order already prepared

examples.en: I sent a pickup reminder before leaving the stall for my afternoon lecture.
examples.zh: 离开摊位去上下午的课之前，我发了条「取货提醒」。

examples.en: The pickup reminder included a photo of the library door nearest our table.
examples.zh: 「取货提醒」附了一张离摊位最近的图书馆入口照片。

words.enDefinition: Record that the prepared goods have been collected by the customer

examples.en: Choose "Mark as collected" after the buyer takes both bags from the counter.
examples.zh: 买家从柜台拿走两袋货后，选择「标记为已取货」。

examples.en: I forgot to click "Mark as collected" after the last pickup on Friday.
examples.zh: 周五最后一单取走后，我忘了点「标记为已取货」。

collocations: mark as collected in the system

words.enDefinition: Make goods available again after they were set aside for someone

examples.en: We agreed to release reserved stock after getting confirmation that the buyer had cancelled.
examples.zh: 我们确认买家已取消订单后，同意「解除这批货的库存预留」。

examples.en: I didn't want to release reserved stock before the club confirmed its final quantities.
examples.zh: 社团还没确认最终要多少，我不想先「把预留的货放回可售库存」。

collocations: decide when to release reserved stock

words.enDefinition: An item the seller offers for collection instead of delivery

examples.en: The framed print was a pickup-only item because I didn't have suitable packaging.
examples.zh: 我没有合适的包装，所以那幅带框的版画是「仅限自取的商品」。

examples.en: I listed each ceramic lamp as a pickup-only item for our market weekend.
examples.zh: 我把每盏陶瓷灯都标为市集周末「仅限自取的商品」。

collocations: mark something as a pickup-only item
a pickup-only item at the fair

words.enDefinition: A planned path for delivering orders to addresses in a nearby area

examples.en: Our local delivery route ends near campus, so I can drop off the largest box last.
examples.zh: 我们的「本地送货路线」终点在学校附近，所以我可以最后送最大的箱子。

examples.en: We grouped three stops on the local delivery route because the customers lived on one road.
examples.zh: 三位顾客住在同一条路上，我们就在「本地送货路线」上把这三站排在一起。

collocations: combine stops on a local delivery route

words.enDefinition: A trip during which someone delivers goods to several customers

examples.en: We finished the delivery round before heading back to campus for our lecture.
examples.zh: 我们跑完「一轮送货行程」，就回学校上课了。

examples.en: I added a stop to the delivery round when the other seller called.
examples.zh: 另一名摊商打来电话时，我给「这轮送货行程」加了一站。

words.enDefinition: A transfer of goods arranged without meeting the other person directly

examples.en: We arranged a contactless handoff for the bags by using the agreed shelf.
examples.zh: 我们用双方说好的架子放袋子，完成了「无接触交接」。

examples.en: The buyer requested a contactless handoff because nobody would be home until much later.
examples.zh: 买家说要很晚才有人到家，于是提出「无接触交接」。

collocations: a contactless handoff at the door

words.enDefinition: An effort to deliver an order that did not result in delivery

examples.en: I recorded a failed delivery attempt and asked the buyer to suggest another time.
examples.zh: 我登记了「一次投递未成功」的情况，请买家另提个时间。

examples.en: We brought the framed print back after a failed delivery attempt at the dorm.
examples.zh: 在宿舍「试送一次没送成」后，我们把带框版画带了回来。

collocations: reschedule after a failed delivery attempt

words.enDefinition: Fabric hanging around the sides of a display table

examples.en: We used a table skirt to keep the spare boxes out of sight.
examples.zh: 我们用「摊桌围布」把备用箱挡住了。

examples.en: I clipped the table skirt to the display table before arranging the cards.
examples.zh: 摆卡片之前，我先把「摊桌围布」夹在陈列桌上。

collocations: hide boxes behind a table skirt

words.enDefinition: A frame that holds a promotional banner upright

examples.en: I moved the banner stand beside the table so customers could see our name.
examples.zh: 我把「横幅展示架」挪到桌边，好让顾客看见我们叫什么。

examples.en: The banner stand folded down small enough to fit in the equipment box.
examples.zh: 「横幅展示架」折起来够小，可以装进设备箱。

words.enDefinition: A small stand that supports a sign on a flat surface

examples.en: We used a tabletop sign holder for the notice about collecting custom orders.
examples.zh: 我们用「桌面标牌架」摆放领取定制订单的告示。

examples.en: The tabletop sign holder tipped over when I moved the box next to it.
examples.zh: 我挪动旁边的箱子时，「桌面标牌架」倒了。

collocations: set out a tabletop sign holder

words.enDefinition: A metal grid used to hang merchandise or attach display hooks

examples.en: We used a gridwall panel to hang the prints above the bags.
examples.zh: 我们用「陈列网格板」把版画挂在包的上方。

examples.en: I carried the gridwall panel into the hall before fetching the hooks.
examples.zh: 我先把「陈列网格板」搬进大厅，再去拿挂钩。

collocations: hang prints on a gridwall panel

words.enDefinition: A small sign attached to a shelf to highlight nearby products

examples.en: I added a shelf talker explaining why the larger notebook had thicker paper.
examples.zh: 我加了一张「货架宣传卡」，解释大号笔记本为什么用了较厚的纸。

examples.en: The shelf talker helped shoppers notice the new design on the bottom shelf.
examples.zh: 「货架宣传卡」让顾客注意到最下层架子上的新品。

collocations: a shelf talker for a new product

words.enDefinition: Count items separately for each code identifying a distinct product version

examples.en: We had to count by SKU because the similar bags had different fabric codes.
examples.zh: 几个包看着差不多，面料代码却不一样，所以我们得「按商品代码盘点」。

examples.en: Let's count by SKU before the fair so we can track colors separately.
examples.zh: 我们在市集前「按商品代码盘点」吧，这样能按颜色分别记录。

collocations: ask everyone to count by SKU

words.enDefinition: Assign a quantity of goods to particular sales locations or orders

examples.en: We needed to allocate stock between the library stall and the craft market.
examples.zh: 我们需要在图书馆摊位和手工市集之间「分配库存货品」。

examples.en: I waited to allocate stock until both student groups had confirmed their orders.
examples.zh: 两个学生小组都确认订单后，我才「分配库存货品」。

words.enDefinition: Unsold goods kept for sale at a later event or period

examples.en: Most of the notebooks were carryover stock from last month's student craft fair.
examples.zh: 大部分笔记本都是上个月学生手工市集的「结转库存」。

examples.en: We counted carryover stock before making anything new for the winter market.
examples.zh: 制作冬季市集新品之前，我们先盘点「上一期的结转库存」。

collocations: carryover stock from the previous market

words.enDefinition: Make goods in advance to keep them available for future orders

examples.en: For our plain notebooks, we make to stock so buyers can collect them immediately.
examples.zh: 素面笔记本是我们「提前按库存备货做的」，买家随时能取。

examples.en: We decided to make to stock for the two designs that always sell quickly.
examples.zh: 有两个款一直卖得很快，我们决定「提前做出来备货」。

collocations: make to stock for regular sales

words.enDefinition: Open arriving packages and take the goods out of them

examples.en: I stayed to unpack a shipment of blank tote bags after everyone else left.
examples.zh: 其他人离开后，我留下来「拆了一批到货」，里面是空白托特包。

examples.en: Can you help unpack a shipment before we arrange the merchandise on the table?
examples.zh: 把货摆上桌之前，你能帮忙「拆开这批刚到的货」吗？

words.enDefinition: A fitted piece placed inside a box to hold its contents

examples.en: I chose a box insert that held the mug and lid separately.
examples.zh: 我挑了一个「包装盒内托」，可以把马克杯和杯盖分开固定。

examples.en: The box insert kept the small ceramic bird in place during transport.
examples.zh: 运输时，「包装盒内托」把陶瓷小鸟固定住了。

words.enDefinition: A tool that holds tape and helps cut off lengths

examples.en: The tape dispenser made it faster to seal boxes at the end of term.
examples.zh: 学期末，「胶带切割器」让我们封箱更快了。

examples.en: Could you leave the tape dispenser by the labels after you close that box?
examples.zh: 你封好那只箱子后，能把「胶带切割器」放在标签旁边吗？

words.zhGloss: 把同一订单的货放一起
words.enDefinition: Keep all the items from one customer purchase in one place
acceptedZhAnswers: 把同一订单的货放一起

examples.en: We used a tray to keep the order together until the envelopes were labelled.
examples.zh: 信封贴好标签之前，我们先用托盘「把同一笔订单的货放在一起」。

examples.en: Can you keep the order together while I check whether the extra mug has arrived?
examples.zh: 我去看看多加的马克杯到了没有，你能先「把这笔订单的货放在一起」吗？

collocations: use a basket to keep the order together
remember to keep the order together
need to keep the order together

words.enDefinition: Change an order's delivery destination after the original destination was arranged

examples.en: We had to redirect a delivery to the campus hall when the studio closed early.
examples.zh: 工作室提前关了，我们不得不把「配送地址改到」校园大厅。

examples.en: I asked if we could redirect a delivery after the buyer switched accommodation.
examples.zh: 买家换住处后，我问能不能「把货改送到另一个地址」。

words.enDefinition: The period or process of bringing sellers' goods into an event venue

examples.en: The organiser sent a map showing which door to use for vendor load-in.
examples.zh: 主办方发了一张地图，标明「摊商进场卸货」走哪个门。

examples.en: We had fifteen minutes for vendor load-in before the next van arrived.
examples.zh: 下一辆货车到来前，有十五分钟供「摊商进场卸货」。

words.enDefinition: The amount of floor area taken up by a booth

examples.en: We checked the booth footprint before borrowing a second table from the studio.
examples.zh: 从工作室再借一张桌子之前，我们确认了「摊位占地尺寸」。

examples.en: The display needs to stay within the booth footprint marked on the floor.
examples.zh: 陈列用具得放在地板标出的「摊位占地范围」内。

words.enDefinition: Count the items in one storage bin again to verify the tally

examples.en: I had to recount a bin when the tally showed one too many notebooks.
examples.zh: 划记表上多了一本笔记本，我只好「把那格货重数一遍」。

examples.en: Could someone recount a bin while I compare the mug totals with the order sheet?
examples.zh: 我核对马克杯总数和订单表时，能请人「重数一格货品」吗？

collocations: ask someone to recount a bin
recount a bin after an error

words.enDefinition: Place prepared orders where they can be collected easily

examples.en: We stage orders for pickup near the front so the queue moves more quickly.
examples.zh: 我们「把订单备放在前面的取货处」，队伍就能走得快些。

examples.en: I stayed to stage orders for pickup before the afternoon customers arrived at the studio.
examples.zh: 我留下来「把订单备放在取货处」，好赶在下午的顾客到工作室前做完。

collocations: stage orders for pickup by time
stage orders for pickup near the door
stage orders for pickup before the fair
